back_translation: In that day you will say: "O LORD, I will give You thanks. Although You were angry with me, Your wrath has turned back, and You comfort me.
Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid. For Yah, the LORD, is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation."
You will draw water with gladness from the springs of salvation.
And in that day you will say: "Give thanks to the LORD; call out His name! Proclaim His royal deeds among the peoples; herald that His name is held in exaltation.
Sing praises to the LORD, for He has done majestic and glorious royal deeds; let this be known throughout all the earth.
Cry aloud and sing with rejoicing, O inhabitants of Zion, for great is the Holy One of Israel, and He dwells in your midst."
